FOURTH EMITTER FOUND (cc-notes lane check-back, source-proven): cc-notes emits nothing — its fusekit-helper plist is generated entirely by FUSEKIT, which hardcodes `LimitLoadToSessionType: SessionTypeAqua` at holder/plan.go:411. cc-notes' cited sites are a declarative attestation (deploymentServicePolicy → policy digest) and a test fixture; zero readers of the field. The value is load-bearing in fusekit's plan digest (:652) and sameAgent (:666) — desirably so: a fixed fusekit makes installed keyed agents compare unequal and get replaced on converge, which is exactly the redeployment path. daemonkit's zero-value SessionType already omits the launchd key (policy.go:46 sessionTypeUnset → template guard), so no daemonkit change is needed for the omission path.

Wave re-scoped to FOUR repos: synckit (both fixes, in flight), captain-hook (in flight), fusekit (new lane: drop :411 + plan_test.go:712), cc-notes (pre-staging its attestation/fixture half on a branch; lands as a repin once fusekit releases — expect v1.15.4 — since cc-notes pins fusekit in go.mod, currently v1.15.2). Release order: fusekit first, then cc-notes repin+release; synckit and captain-hook independent. Also noted: cc-notes has the same missing-process-cap-harness gap as cookiesync (AGENTS.md prescribes bare go test) — being filed in its backlog.
